text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? King-san,
aren't you eating your breakfast yogurt?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because I am aiming for perfect conditioning
heading into the next race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Give it to me then!
No matter how much I eat, I'm still hungry~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind, but... are you okay?
Like, with the... flab and everything?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: For my part, I insist that my rivals be in prime condition as well, otherwise—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm totally fine!
My lifestyle is as tight as an amulet's drawstring...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, would you show it to me?
The clasp on your skirt, that is!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What in the world is happening?!
A hook just came flying at me?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe...
Talk about divine punishment, haha, just kidding.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Fukukitaru-san, go do some laps.
That's your punishment for hitting King's forehead!

Thanks to the morning run,
Matikane Fukukitaru managed to shake off her sluggishness...
